validation_cohort_policy: Use the pre-existing 1740-frame PaDU validation cohort (valid cached feature plus both existing scene-label records). Excludes four frames already absent from that cohort, including one ambiguous mixed box/polygon annotation. Retain all 5945 training images and leave all original annotation files unchanged. This is not an architecture-only matched detector benchmark.
protocol_note: HF fine-tuning adaptation, not an exact reproduction of the official COCO training recipe: same optimizer scale, 72-epoch cap, no EMA/multiscale/mosaic, resize plus horizontal flip, val-loss early stopping. COCO classification head is retained, labels aligned by category name. Existing split leakage limitations remain.
